full_judgment:
"A. Pass a decree. declaring that the initiation of arbitration proceeding by the defendant No.1 in Singapore bearing reference No.1 8477/CYK with the defendant No.7 as Sole Arbitrator and/or any other arbitrator(s), the continuation thereof and any order or award passed there under are illegal, void and not enforceable against the plaintiff. 

 B. Pass a decree of permanent injunction restraining the defendant No.1 from further proceeding with the arbitration bearing reference No.184 77 /CYK with the defendant No.7 as Sole Arbitrator and/or any other arbitrator(s) or from enforcing any order or award passed there under against the plaintiff. 

 5. Mr. Mahmudul Islam, learned Counsel, appearing for the petitioners, has taken serious objection as to the disposal of the revision application by the High Court Division in" a summary manner giving full relief to the plaintiff-respondent without issuing any Rule and thus giving no chance of hearing to the defendant-petitioners against whom ad-interim order of injunction was passed by the Assistant Judge to their great prejudice. He has further submitted that rule 5 of Order XLI of the Code has clearly empowered the Appellate Court, here the District Judge, to pass an order of stay of operation of the order or decree passed by the Court Sub-ordinate to it and in the facts and circumstances of the case, the learned District Judge did not commit any error of law in passing the order impugned in the revision application. Therefore, on merit the High Court Division ought not to have also interfered with the order of the District Judge and, as such, the impugned order calls for interference by this Division and leave be granted.
